# Hassell

> > Hassell is an award-winning global architecture and design studio creating resilient, regenerative places through integrated architecture, urban design, landscape architecture, and interior design.

Hassell is a multi-disciplinary design firm with studios across Brisbane, Asia, UK, and US, specializing in urban design, workplace innovation, cultural precincts, and sustainable infrastructure. The studio combines architecture with strategic research to address evolving challenges in cities, higher education, senior living, and public transport.

## Key Topics

- Urban Design
- Architecture
- Landscape Architecture
- Interior Design
- Regenerative Design

- [Impact](https://www.hassellstudio.com/impact): Sustainability framework, commitments and regenerative design approach for social impact.
- [Impact Home](https://www.hassellstudio.com/impact/impact-home): Sustainability framework and regenerative design commitments for inclusive, resilient cities.

## Project Portfolio

- [Our Projects](https://www.hassellstudio.com/projects): Portfolio of award-winning projects across architecture, urban design, landscape and interior disciplines.
- [All Projects](https://www.hassellstudio.com/projects/all): Complete project gallery across architecture, urban design, landscape and interior disciplines.
- [205 North Quay](https://www.hassellstudio.com/project/205-north-quay): Commercial office tower in Brisbane with wellness-focused workplace design and sustainability.
- [Metro Tunnel](https://www.hassellstudio.com/project/metro-tunnel): Melbourne Metro Tunnel infrastructure with biophilic landscape design and underground stations.
- [Ngurra: National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Cultural Precinct](https://www.hassellstudio.com/project/ngurra-the-national-aboriginal-and-torres-strait-islander-cultural-precinct): Architectural concept for Canberra cultural landmark honoring First Nations history.

## Insights & Research

- [Insight](https://www.hassellstudio.com/insight): News, events, research and conversations on resilient cities, workplace futures and sustainability.
- [Insight Featured](https://www.hassellstudio.com/insight/featured): Featured insights on resilient cities, workplace design and post-COVID urban planning.
- [Senior living in dense cities: building dignity and choice](https://www.hassellstudio.com/research/senior-living-in-dense-cities-building-dignity-and-choice): Research report on senior housing solutions in dense cities like Hong Kong and Tokyo.
- [The future campus: higher education design evolution](https://www.hassellstudio.com/conversation/the-future-campus-how-good-design-is-addressing-the-evolving-needs-of-higher-education): Conversation on campus design addressing evolving higher education community hub needs.
- [Integrated station developments: Shaping cities beyond transport](https://www.hassellstudio.com/conversation/integrated-station-developments-shaping-cities-beyond-transport): Conversation on transit-oriented mixed-use precincts transforming urban mobility and community.
